ad-principlesLoads6 text files, 14,576 characterssent to: script, script primary text

What makes an ad work, as principles and not as a structure. Sent to the writer of any ad (a script for UGC, claymation, a VSL, a static, long ad copy) in place of a beat order, after the order of priority for every word (skills/copy-floor). Covers saying it like a person, the thread from the buyer's before state to the after state with the product as the bridge, the reason for the ad, the brand's voice and length. Distilled from the 2 transcripts Kevin gave on 2026-10-05, the Copy Machine material, the native ad skill, and Kevin's reading of 30 test scripts. The notes for each format are in formats/; the notes for each stage are in skills/buyer-stage; how a long story is told is in skills/copy-craft/parts/long-story.md.

ad-script-principlesLoads14 text files, 44,030 characterssent to: script, transpose

Reference library of what a good direct-response ad script is, for any D2C brand, split into sections (desire and research, buyer stage, offer, claims and specificity, the 9 beats, problem, promise and mechanism, hook and bridges, objections proof and call to action, identity, story, voice, length and format). It describes; it does not instruct. Task skills (script-from-research, script-reference-structure, script-reference-principles, ad-reference-exact) and format skills (script-format-*) load only the sections they need. Do not use on its own to write an ad.

copy-principlesLoads2 text files, 19,164 characterssent to: copy pass

The copy pass. Reads a finished ad script, or the words of an image ad (on-image headline, points, primary text, headline field), as a direct-response copywriter would and mends the lines a person would not say or that don't sell - plain words first, then the promise, specifics in place of adjectives, the headline, the lead, proof, price, the ask. Use after the words are written and before the voice pass. Changes how well a line sells, never what the brand claims. Distilled from Ogilvy on Advertising and the writers it draws on (Hopkins, Caples, Kennedy, Burnett, Rubicam, Bernbach), kept to what holds for D2C ecommerce ads today.

Turn an approved image plan (what the image argues, its exact words if it has any, its scene and layout) into the finished prompt for an image model that takes reference images. Use for every static ad, product-page gallery image and photoshoot frame, for any D2C product, after the plan is approved and before rendering. Covers naming each attached photo by its job, holding the product to its photos and its recorded facts, type and colour from the brand look, words on the image, layout zones, whether the picture makes physical sense, and the checks an output must pass. Not for deciding what an image says (the plan does that) or for video prompts.

landing-pagesLoads16 text files, 859,508 characters, 10 other filessent to: cro audit, cro plan, lp write

The method for building and judging D2C ecommerce landing pages, for any product a brand sells online. Carry on from the ad that sent the visitor, answer what a buyer needs before buying in the order they need it, on a phone, and change the sections and the offer block by the kind of product (bought again, or bought once). Measure revenue per visitor, fix what moves the page most first (clarity, copy, offer, proof, friction). Loaded by the Landing pages module's writer, its checks and its CRO audit.
